description: We're building SolSurvivor, a browser game for kids aged 7-12 for the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. Players run a base on Mars (Jezero Crater) or the Moon's south pole, splitting solar power between air, food, shelter and science each sol, using real NASA data (DONKI, MOXIE, Curiosity RAD). English & Arabic, accessible, works offline, with team and class modes. We welcome coders, designers, storytellers and space science fans. Play: https://tarekkharsa.github.io/solsurvivor/
